Every fair constant-child split obeys B/d<=2+log2(e)/sqrt(e)<3, so control-first activation creates no threshold-4 bad-node credit and scales the full active core ledger by 2^-r. For every real theta>=8, log2(theta)-3<=P(theta)<=log2(theta)+307/45, hence P(theta)/log2(theta)->1.
